theme: An open day braced against a heavy tomorrow.
greeting: The day is genuinely yours, Dan — nothing on today's calendar. Tomorrow leans hard into Mike's medical appointments and Thursday's surgery, so today's real work is the prep that makes those go smoothly.

needsAttention.detail: Your Sustainalytics question came back warm and personal, and she's expecting a reply while the thread is still fresh.

needsAttention.detail: Throat ultrasound at 9:30 and a brain MRI at 3:30 tomorrow, plus a Jomon call in the evening — worth mapping the drive and soft-food run tonight.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer on the Maine coast has the farmstands at their peak, and a composed salad lets ripe tomatoes and briny French feta carry a warm, low-effort evening on your own.

acts.line: The calendar is clear — a rare open stretch before tomorrow's medical run.
Yours to spend, with the surgery-week prep as the one thing that can't wait.
Tomorrow opens with Mike's 9:30 ultrasound, so tee up the driver and the soft-food stock tonight.
